meta.title: Bootlift: Spring Boot 4 readiness check for pull requests
meta.description: Open-source GitHub Action that scores Spring Boot 4 readiness, blocks new migration debt in pull requests and suggests one-click fixes. No JDK, no build.

hero.title: Upgrade to Spring Boot 4 without the migration debt.
hero.subtitle: Bootlift scores Spring Boot 4 readiness on every pull request, fails only on the lines you add, and turns fixes into one-click suggestions. In seconds, with no JDK and no build.

footer.tagline: Spring Boot 4 readiness, checked on every pull request.

prCard.label: Animation of the Bootlift demo pull request. Old code pushed to the PR drops the Spring Boot 4 readiness score from 94 to 60 and the check fails. Bootlift suggests replacing javax.servlet with jakarta.servlet; committing the suggestion brings the score back to 94 and the check passes.
